city.doc: n18 living police in the streamed city (CityHeat, the sim's set_police): drain_s_per_level replaces the quest's for the city; foot_cops[level] = cops engaged at heat 0..3 (nearest the last-seen point first); they search search_s once one is within arrive_m of it, then walk again; a free cop walks at walk_mps; patrol_cops foot cops are kept on the bubble's sidewalks (CityPatrol); living_police false = the pre-n18 sim police (every cop pursues Rivet).

doc: Heat (wanted) in Act 1 (quest collect-call mechanic `heat`): 0 to max_level; one level drains per drain_s_per_level seconds out of every human sight (sight_m); being seen restarts the count.
